sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression Technical Report 👁️ Introduction We introduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens. The model natively processes images and text, and generates text autoregressively.
